lines: Whatever the browser can draw, the race goes on.
Where neither WebGPU nor WebGL two can draw, the map's panorama takes the world's place, and the race still runs.
Switch tabs, and the world stops drawing. The race clock and your power carry on.
Main's loop already stopped, but the scene still drew a frame each time the clock ticked. Now a hidden tab draws nothing at all.
Come back, and the world draws again, the race twenty seconds further on.
From a phone to a desktop, the panorama fills the screen behind the race.
What the tests prove: a hidden tab draws no frame while the race runs on, and shown again, it draws.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
